sanskrit: āgan rātrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ vasv āveśayantī | amāvāsyāyai haviṣā vidhema- -ūrjaṃ vasānā payasā na āgan ||
english: Night has come, she who gathers together riches, installing all nourishment and goods. Let us honor the new-moon night with oblation — clothed in vigor, she has come to us with milk.

sanskrit: mā tvā rātri puro daghan mota paścād vibhāvari | āyuṣmantaḥ suprajasaḥ suvīrā ṛdhyāsma tvā suvarcasaḥ ||
english: Let her not burn you before, nor from behind, O resplendent Night. May we prosper — long-lived, with excellent offspring, endowed with good heroes, of fine radiance — in your keeping, O Night.

sanskrit: yasya devasya sumatau sunītir eti sumatiṃ gṛhāṇām | ā mā puṣṭaṃ ca poṣyaṃ ca rātryā devānāṃ sumatau syāma ||
english: By the benevolence of that deity, right conduct moves toward the benevolence of householders. May both what nourishes me now and what shall nourish me in future be gathered in — may we abide in the benevolence of the divine Night.

sanskrit: aham evāsmy amāvāsyā- -amā vasanti sukṛto mayīme | mayi devā ubhaye sādhyāś ca- -indrajyeṣṭhāḥ sam agacchanta sarve ||
english: I myself am the new-moon night: the well-doers dwell at home in me. In me all the gods of both orders — the Sādhyas and those led by Indra — have come together.

sanskrit: prathamā ha vy uvāsa sā dhenur abhavad yame | sā naḥ payasvatī duhā uttarāmuttarāṃ samām ||
english: She who first shone forth became a cow at the twin nights. May she, rich in milk, yield to us each succeeding year.

sanskrit: yāṃ devāḥ pratinandanti dhenuṃ rātrīm upāyatīm | saṃvatsarasya yā patnī sā no astu sumaṅgalī ||
english: The Night that approaches as a cow, whom the gods acclaim with joy, who is the spouse of the year — may she be of great good omen to us.

sanskrit: saṃvatsarasya pratimāṃ ye tvā rātry upāsate | teṣām āyuṣmatīṃ prajāṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ sṛja ||
english: Those who worship you, O Night, as the image of the year — unite their progeny, endowed with long life, with abundance of wealth.

sanskrit: iyam eva sā yā prathamā vyaucchat sāpsv antar āsu carati praviṣṭā | vadhūr jigāya navagaj janitrī traya enāṃ mahimānaḥ sacante ||
english: This very one is she who first shone forth; she moves within the waters, having entered into them. A bride, she conquered — young, a mother — three greatnesses attend upon her.

sanskrit: vānaspatyā grāvāṇo ghoṣam akrata haviṣ kṛṇvantaḥ parivatsarīṇam | ekāṣṭake suprajasaḥ suvīrā vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
english: The wooden press-stones have raised their sound, preparing the annual oblation. On the eighth lunar day of the year's turn, O Ekāṣṭakā, may we be endowed with excellent offspring and good heroes, lords of wealth.

sanskrit: iḍāyās padaṃ ghṛtavat sarīsṛpaṃ jātavedaḥ prati havyā gṛbhāya | ye grāmyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpās teṣāṃ saptānāṃ mayi rantir astu ||
english: O Jātavedas, receive the offerings unto the station of Iḍā, the place that flows with ghee, gliding forward. Of the seven kinds of domestic animals of all forms, may their delight be in me.

sanskrit: iḍayā juhvato havir devān ghṛtavatā yaje | gṛhān alubhyato vayaṃ dṛṣadomopa gomataḥ ||
english: With Iḍā I pour oblation, rich in ghee; I worship the gods. May we, free from greed, approach the grinding-stone in the household that is rich in cattle.

sanskrit: yaja rtubhya ārtavebhyo mādbhyaḥ saṃvatsarāya ca | dhātre vidhartre samṛdhe bhūtasya pataye yaja ||
english: Sacrifice to the seasons, to the seasonal rites, to the monthly ones, and to the year. Sacrifice to Dhātṛ and Vidhātṛ, to Samṛdh, to the Lord of all beings.
